summary: A friendly call to reach out through hard times and connect with others.
A defiant rock anthem about a rough childhood and a rebel's pride.
A lost lover's cake metaphor leads to a bitter reflection on a shattered romance.
A flirtatious plea to set the night on fire and chase a shared high.
A tongue-tied singer struggles to say I love you and feels held back.
A man ignores his mother's warning to slow down and learns his fiancee cheated.
A haunted narrator sees a lover's face everywhere and cannot shake the image.
A worker fumes about low pay, a summer with no money and a dismissive boss.
A singer insists a photo or letter cannot replace the real person they love.
A bouncy celebration of a feeling that rises and falls with love and mood.
A condemned man begs a preacher to deliver a farewell message to the woman he wronged.
A sympathetic portrait of a struggling mother juggling children, rent and hard days.
A dreamy vision of a wandering singer who brings songs of love by the sea.
A dreamer invites a girl on a magic carpet ride of fantasy and escape.
A drunk pleads to be allowed home and to start over after another binge.
A plea to a lover to stay close and keep loving the narrator.
A jealous man confronts a woman who betrayed him and loses control in a fatal rage.
A cocky dance boast claiming nobody can perform the moves like the singer.
A soul singer thanks a lover for the affection and passion received.
A reflection on a solitary man on a hill whom others dismiss as a fool.
A chaplain blesses young soldiers who march into battle and many who will die.
A jingle inviting families to a lake town with canoes, coves and summer fun.
A lovesick singer wonders what a former partner is doing tonight.
A heartbroken narrator cannot stop thinking about a former lover.
A medley of two love songs about being wild over a sweetheart.
A singer vows to win over a cheating man's partner and claim her heart.
A Noah's ark tale in which the unicorns are left behind and never seen again.
A woman begs an ex to set her free because he will not really let go.
A song that wants change but refuses destruction and calls for patience.
A worried lover accuses a woman of wanting to cheat and sees it in her looks.
A giddy love song to a girl the narrator adores despite her family.
A lonely narrator in a dim room mourns a lover who left by train.
A devoted lover pledges loyalty and promises to be there in every need.
A man begs a lover not to leave, promising to build his world around her.
A singer says a lover's sweet words are the inspiration that keeps going.
A lover promises to stay near whenever the other needs him, through wanting and caring.
A man in a cab begs the driver to pass his lost love's home one more time.
A call to young people to take their own path as the time has come.
A lost traveler asks the way to a hometown seeking peace and a fresh start.
A traveler asks someone to remember a lost love and a list of impossible tasks.
An anthem declaring pride in being Black and refusing to live on one's knees.
A playful song about a mysterious figure who will sort out everyone's chaos.
A playful courtroom comedy where a judge sets the rules for dancing and fun.
A woman's morning and workday are full of silent prayers for her loved one.
A forceful demand that the listener think and stop playing games with a partner.
A summer parting promise to send love by letter, sealed with a kiss.
A defiant lover says she will keep giving her heart despite the pain.
A simple love song praising a girl's walk and talk and her faithfulness.
A lover willingly lets a partner shape her however they like if they love her.
A man begs a telegram messenger to deliver a longing message to his girl.
